description:
In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides. Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there’s a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

 *“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”*

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode. 

 *“Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”

“But sir, your erection says otherwise.”*

Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it’s with the one person he never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four side story chapters.*
